subject: Thank you for applying to Northwind Robotics
why: plain receipt; 'Thanks for applying' phrasing and a contraction the strict patterns used to miss
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for applying to Northwind Robotics! Confirming we've received your application for the following role:

Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer
Job ID: 44120

Our teams will review your application and reach out if there is a match.

subject: An update on your application to Northwind Robotics - Senior Backend Engineer
why: negated advancement: 'unable to move forward' must not score as an invitation
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your application for the position of Senior Backend Engineer. Unfortunately, at this time we are unable to move forward with your application.

We wish you success in your search.

subject: Contoso: Interview Request!
why: genuine invitation; 'next stage' must not be read as a second round
body:
Hi Alex,

We would like to invite you to the next stage of the interview process for the Staff Platform Engineer role, a video interview with our Engineering Manager.

Could you share your availability this week?

subject: Re: Contoso: Interview Request!
why: same scheduling episode as d3, so it must not become a second round
body: Great - confirming your video interview for Monday at 10:00. Calendar invite to follow.

subject: Thank you for your interest
why: receipt from an ATS tenant address; company must come from the local part, not 'Myworkday'
body:
Dear Alex,

Thank you for your interest in a career at Contoso. We have received your application for the Staff Platform Engineer role.

One of our Talent Acquisition Specialists will be in touch if we choose to move forward.

subject: Verify your candidate account
why: account plumbing subjected like a receipt; never an application response
body: Click this link to confirm your email address and complete setup for your candidate account. The link will expire after 24 hours.

subject: Your assessment invitation
why: assessment invite that mentions an interview in passing, sent by an ATS vendor so the employer comes from the body
body: You have been invited to complete an online assessment for the Senior Data Engineer role at Fabrikam. If one of the assessments is a video interview, please check your camera. The link will expire in 7 days.

subject: Termination of Employment
why: a layoff letter is worded exactly like a rejection
body:
Dear Alex,

We regret to inform you that, after careful evaluation, the decision has been made to terminate your employment, effective immediately.

We wish you the best.

subject: Reminder: You have an upcoming interview with Contoso
why: reminder for an already-booked interview: neither a receipt nor a new invitation
body: This is a reminder that your interview with Contoso is scheduled for tomorrow at 10:00.

subject: Senior Software Engineer opportunity
why: personal webmail sender is not an employer's recruiting system
body: Hi Alex, I would like to invite you to interview for a Senior Software Engineer role. Please share your availability.

subject: Thank you for applying to Fabrikam
why: conditional pipeline description, not an offer
body: Thanks for applying to Fabrikam! We have received your application for the Senior Data Engineer role. Next Steps: successful candidates move on to a video interview with the hiring team. We will be in touch about next steps if you are selected to move forward.

subject: Home Owner Grant Application
why: 'application' with no hiring context at all
body: Your home owner grant application has been submitted. Confirmation Number: 2-001-018.

subject: Thanks for your interest in Databricks, CHANGHONG!
why: ack subject over a decline body; 'decision to not move forward FOR your application' is the same sentence as 'not moving forward with', and the ack rules must not outrank it
body:
Hi CHANGHONG,

Thank you for your application to Databricks!

After reviewing your skills and experience, we have made the decision to not move forward for your application for the Senior Software Engineer - Backend position at this time.

Please feel free to check our careers page, we are always updating our website with new opportunities.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best of luck in your search!

Warm regards,
Databricks Talent Acquisition

subject: 23 new openings - check for Software Engineer roles
why: job board advert. Glassdoor counts as an ATS platform for the prefilter, which waved every digest past the job-context gate and into the review queue
body: Companies actively hiring near you. See new open roles this month and apply now. Interview tips that land dream roles.

subject: Thank you for applying to Contoso
why: a receipt whose only reject cue is a sign-off pleasantry stays a receipt. Tightening the ack branch to outrank a weak reject score filed five real confirmations as rejections
body: Thank you for applying to Contoso. We have received your application for the Backend Engineer role and our recruiting team will review it shortly. Unfortunately, due to the volume of interest we cannot reply to every candidate individually. We wish you the best of luck in your job search!
